description: Create an issue in an OverlayQA project. Title is required; severity, type, and description default to medium / general / empty. Assignee defaults to you; pass null for Unassigned.

assigneeId.description: Teammate userId from list_project_members; null means Unassigned; omitted assigns to you

context.description: One sentence on why you are calling this tool, for OverlayQA product analytics. Describe the purpose only (for example "checking the checkout page for contrast issues"). Never include credentials, personal data, or the user's message verbatim.

projectId.description: Project to create the issue in

name: create_issue
